messages:
Nina: Heads-up: PR 539 touches a handful of doc areas (style guide, SDK examples, and the glossary). I spotted inconsistent product names and a confusing glossary line about rollout. Can we align before merge? :wave:
Arjun: Which names are slipping through?
Nina: Quick scan:
- some pages say "hosted API" while others use "Redwood API"
- references to "Dedicated" alone vs "Dedicated capacity"
- mixed SDK examples: `client.text.generate(...)`, `client.generate(...)`, and the newer `client.chat.completions.create(...)`
- rollout glossary entry reads like a mash of canary/A-B terms

Maya: Agree we should pick canonical short names. Suggest adding a small canonical list at the top of the style guide so PRs link there. Minimal bullets only.
Arjun: Latest SDK pattern in our Python examples should be `client.chat.completions.create(...)` for chat-based completions. If we need a text-only shorthand, include a one-line adapter example.
Nina: Draft canonical bullets I'll add to the style guide: 
- Redwood API our hosted inference endpoint (hosted)
- Dedicated capacity reserved GPU pools with tenant isolation
- Private deployment VPC/on-prem customers

Maya: For glossary, propose we replace "rollout" phrasing with "staged rollout" and a succinct directive. Draft: "staged rollout (n.) deploying a model to production in controlled stages. Begin with a canary (small traffic slice) to validate latency and quality, then incrementally increase traffic. Use \"A/B\" only when comparing distinct cohorts and metrics."

Arjun: I like the concise version. Add one-line example in parentheses: (e.g., Canary 5% -> monitor latency/accuracy -> ramp to 100%).
Nina: Will add the canonical bullets, swap the glossary text, and run a repo-wide grep to update SDK examples. Also found a broken link in the migration guide: `/docs/migrate/v2-to-v3#batching` returned 404 when I ran linkcheck locally.
docs-bot: [link-check] PR 539: 1 broken internal link found https://ci.redwood/docs-linkcheck/539

Maya: Tiny voice note: prefer present-tense and active verbs (e.g., "Use X to do Y" not "X is used to do Y"). Keep sentences short in the style guide.
Arjun: For the SDK snippet changes, propose adding a short compatibility note in the migration guide showing old vs new: 
```
# old
resp = client.generate(model="...", prompt="...")
# new
resp = client.chat.completions.create(model="...", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"..."}])
```
This should help users migrating examples.

Nina: OK I'll push these edits: canonical bullets at top of style guide, glossary swap to "staged rollout" with example, replace SDK snippets across `docs/sdk` and `guides`, and fix the migration link to point to the right anchor. ETA ~30m. Anyone able to do a quick voice/API pass after?
Theo: I can review for voice and leftover old API usage after you push (10-15m).
Nina: Pushed. PR note: "canonical terms + staged rollout + SDK snippet migration + fixed migration anchor". CI starting.
docs-bot: CI: link-check started for PR 539 https://ci.redwood/docs-linkcheck/539

Theo: Scanning the branch now. Found one stray example in `examples/quickstart.md` still using `client.text.generate(...)`; pushed a tiny commit to the branch.

Nina: Thanks! Re-running linkcheck locally before asking CI to run again.
docs-bot: [link-check] PR 539: 0 broken links. :white_check_mark:

Theo: Voice pass done. Left two micro-nits: a stray passive sentence and one sentence that could be shorter. I added inline suggestions.
Maya: Quick approval from me once those nits are addressed.
Nina: Addressed both nits and squashed. CI green. Anyone opposed to merging after CI? :+1:
Arjun: :+1:
Maya: :+1:
Theo: :+1: merging now.
Nina: Merged. Thanks everyone — this should cut down future vocabulary drift. If you see anything odd post-merge ping me here. :tada:
